entry_state: The query contract now preserves input domain, rounding order, attained endpoints, reusable economic state and unresolved conditional mass. Equal displays or terminal cash do not establish equivalent histories. The numerical-method discussion has introduced an effective-rate root for positive payments; its derivative and error-controlled solution continue on the next page.
exit_state: Chapter 6 has defined compatibility, answer families, accounting invariants, simulation, probability and computational limits. Its root-finding, Bayesian and Gaussian examples distinguish numerical validity from information identity and accounting authority; its causal example distinguishes stress, observation and intervention. The undefined theta remains the sole confirmed new defect. The language chapter must now encode these semantics in portable declarations and checks.
findings: Positive-payment monotonicity supports a unique root in a certified sign-changing bracket; mixed-sign cash flows are explicitly outside that argument. Posting requires a whole enclosure inside one rounding cell.
Finite Bayes updating preserves unresolved posterior mass and semantic observation identity. Exact equality constraints require a declared lower-dimensional measure or a genuine error model.
The linear Gaussian calculation gives posterior mean 8/5 and variance 4/5 in its scalar example; an independent second observation differs from an invalid reuse of the first.
The causal example yields Y=3 under observation X=1 but a 2/3 outcome law with mean 2.5 under intervention. Financial reports do not establish the assumed structural equations.
No additional defect on pages 94–96. The chapter closes with one previously recorded notation repair trigger, R347-D01.
